svg.title: Slant — Thoughts are passing clouds
svg.desc: “Thoughts are passing clouds. Left alone, they vanish into thin air. Gathered and condensed, they bring the rain that nourishes the earth.” Slant nib-and-thinker logo and a cloud-and-rain illustration. All visible artwork and lettering are vector paths. Scale proportionally to the available page width. A bold plum, indigo, teal, amber and rose perimeter makes the panel distinct on a cream editorial page.
svg.metadata: Standalone vector quote panel. Native aspect ratio: 7:3. Cream background. No external images, scripts or fonts. Text is outlined to prevent font substitution.
